params.body:
Two things about how a post opens in the writing view: who it is by, and its cover.

## Byline under the standfirst

The byline sat at the foot of the sheet, beside Goes to, Stage and Read by, so opening a live post did not show who it is by. It now stands under the standfirst, as gentells.com shows it, with the date a post went live.

- An admin chooses the Editorial Team (first), one of the writers, or Another name... for a writer without an account. The writers are every name a piece is signed with, most used first, from `GET /articles/bylines` (pipeline PR). A name typed once is offered from then on.
- The author keeps the choice between their own name and the Editorial Team. Everyone else reads the name.
- Only the name shown changes; the owner of the piece (`author_id`) stays.
- Against a pipeline without the route, the list falls back to the current and own name.

## Cover where the post opens

- The cover stands clean at the top. Hovering shows one round control (always shown on touch screens), which opens a window to choose: the piece's own pictures, pictures from its sources, Upload, Paste a link, Remove the cover, Close. Escape and a click outside close it.
- Without a cover, an editor sees an empty place, "+ Add a cover", that opens the same window. A reader of someone else's piece sees nothing there.
- The pictures in a piece's text now count among its own. Guilherme's posts carry theirs in the body, and the pool only knew uploads, links and PDF covers.
- The margin's cover panel stays as it was, with the text's pictures added.

## Checks

- `npm test` 44/44, `vite build` clean.
- Checked in a local Studio against a copy of production: an admin changed a live post's byline to a guest writer's name and it saved (`{"authorName": ...}`); an editor who is neither admin nor author saw the name as text; the cover control appears on hover, the window opens and closes, and the pictures from the text appear among the choices.

Merge the pipeline PR with `GET /articles/bylines` first.
params.title: Write: the byline under the standfirst, and the cover changed from the cover itself
